newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Foreigners invest $870 mln in Israel high tech.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners invest $870 mln in Israel high tech.

text.p: Foreigners invested some $870 million in Israeli high technology companies in the first 11 months of the year, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Monday.

It said the figure compared with $240 million for all of 1995 and $26 million in 1994. In 1996, $550 million of the total was direct investment and the remainder through public offerings, most of them in the United States.

Joshua Gleitman, the ministry's director-general, noted that the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange had almost no role in raising capital for Israel's high-tech companies and said this could hurt their ability to raise cpaital in the future.
